# royal_esplanade_1k.hdr

Equirectangular HDR environment, 1024x512, used as the default 3D viewport backdrop and image-based lighting.

Based on **Royal Esplanade** by Greg Zaal, licensed [CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/royal_esplanade — copied from
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js (r170, examples/textures/equirectangular/royal_esplanade_1k.hdr)

No modifications: the file is used as published.
